trust_decision.summary: A checkpoint identifier is trusted only when it is a string, and MongoDBSaver decides that per call site before the identifier reaches a MongoDB query filter: configurable.thread_id/checkpoint_ns/checkpoint_id in getTuple, list, put and putWrites, plus the bare threadId argument of deleteThread, in libs/checkpoint-mongodb/src/checkpoint.ts.

landing_point.why: The summary names MongoDBSaver and checkpoint identifiers for cross-tenant state access; getTuple is the first read path that turns configurable.thread_id/checkpoint_ns/checkpoint_id straight into a MongoDB find filter.

public async-iterator API method of the saver class

public write API method of the saver class
public lower-level API taking a bare id instead of a RunnableConfig

O3_reason_to_dismiss: MongoDBStore is a different class for a different feature, its search() explicitly accepts operator objects in filter values, and the advisory names MongoDBSaver's checkpoint identifiers — so the store's key/namespace filters and putWrites' taskId can be argued to be outside the protected surface.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: getTuple and list must stay tolerant of a config that omits identifiers: a missing thread_id means 'no match' (getTuple returns undefined, list applies no thread filter) and a missing checkpoint_ns defaults to ""/no filter, while only put requires thread_id and only putWrites requires all three — a single shared validator that throws on every missing field breaks existing callers.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: putWrites builds the checkpoint_writes upsert filter with the taskId argument unvalidated (task_id: taskId)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: taskId is generated by the graph executor rather than supplied in the caller's config, so it reads as trusted internal state.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: put uses checkpoint.id (the first argument's own id) in the updateOne upsert filter without a string check
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: checkpoint.id comes from the serialized checkpoint object, not from configurable, so it looks outside the advisory's 'configurable checkpoint IDs'.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: MongoDBStore.get -> getOp builds find({namespace, key}) with neither the namespace nor the key validated
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: MongoDBStore is a separate long-term store; the advisory and its fix speak only about MongoDBSaver checkpoint identifiers.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: one file, same package; reached via libs/checkpoint/src/store/base.ts:404

O8_uncovered_routes.route: MongoDBStore put/delete build {namespace, key} filters with the key never checked (namespace is checked at :325)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The store's key is not a checkpoint identifier, and put/delete are a neighbouring feature to the checkpoint saver.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: MongoDBStore.search injects unvalidated namespacePrefix labels into dot-notation namespace.${idx} filter keys
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: search() is documented to accept operator objects in filter values, so object-valued input there looks like intended behaviour rather than injection.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: one file, same package; reached via libs/checkpoint/src/store/base.ts:430

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a sibling raw-id method such as deleteCheckpoint(threadId, checkpointNs, checkpointId) or pruneThreads(threadIds) building deleteMany filters
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: deleteThread already takes a bare string and builds two deleteMany filters from it, so a maintainer adding a second maintenance API would copy that shape.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a helper that lists pending writes for a thread by filtering checkpoint_writes on thread_id/checkpoint_ns/checkpoint_id
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: getTuple already queries the writes collection with the same three fields, so exposing that lookup publicly is a natural addition.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a TTL-refresh get path that reuses the {namespace, key} filter (the findOneAndUpdate branch already does)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the refreshOnRead branch copies the same filter, so any new store read would repeat it without validation.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: an extended search that adds more namespace-prefix dot-notation keys from caller input
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the dot-notation loop is the established way this file filters namespaces, and list's metadata filter (:170-180) already shows the project knows to reject operator objects, so a maintainer could assume the guard covers the neighbour.

O9_family: CWE-943 improper neutralization of special elements in data query logic (NoSQL operator injection into MongoDB query filters)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a typeof thread_id === "string" check only in getTuple (the field the summary implies) and stop once that path throws.

out_of_scope_notes: Other checkpoint backends in the monorepo (checkpoint-postgres, checkpoint-redis, checkpoint-sqlite) have their own savers on parameterized SQL/key-value APIs; not this Mongo sink, not pursued.
